items.t: Stability control may brake or cut power unexpectedly
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 05V-119. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Parking brake may not hold
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 05V-315. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Driver air bag protection for small occupants
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 07V-197. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Brake light switch failure
items.note: Often free under Hyundai brake light switch recalls 09V-122, 09V-280 and 13V-113. Check your VIN first. Price shown is for a paid repair; labor from YourMechanic for the Accent, which uses a similar switch.

items.t: Harsh or delayed shifts and solenoid codes
items.note: Check fluid level and condition first. If the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Passenger air bag sensor misreads occupant
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 10V-061. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Rough shifting and transmission temperature codes
items.note: A software update and fluid change sometimes fix it. If the transmission must be replaced, expect much more.

items.t: Transmission cooler hose may leak
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 16V-057. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Engine knock and bearing wear
items.note: Based on the 2014-2015 2.4L: Hyundai reman sub-engine 21101-2GK36 (sale price to MSRP, plus a refundable $1,000 core) and Hyundai warranty times of 6.0-7.6 hours in campaign T3G bulletin 20-01-024H-2. Certain 2014-2015 2.4L engines are covered by campaign T3G; check your VIN first. 2.0L engine cost not confirmed.

items.t: Engine oil pan may leak
items.job: Replace oil pan and oil pressure switch
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 19V-063. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: ABS control module fire risk
items.job: Replace ABS fuse per recall (plus software on 2019-2021)
items.note: Free dealer repair under recalls 23V-651 (2010-2013), 22V-056 (2014-2015) and 20V-543 (2016-2021). Park outside until it is done. Check your VIN.

items.t: Steering wheel air bag may come loose
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 14V-245. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Dual-clutch transmission hesitation and shudder
items.job: Replace double clutch and update transmission software
items.note: Many cases are fixed by the free software update (recall 16V-628 on 2016 models, bulletin 21-AT-014H). Parts: Hyundai double clutch 41200-2D220, sale price to MSRP. Hours: Hyundai warranty times in bulletins 19-AT-002H (3.6) and 21-AT-014H (3.8). It may be covered under the powertrain warranty.

items.t: Engine bearing wear and knocking
items.note: Free dealer repair only for 2017 models covered by recall 21V-727. Other years may have extended engine coverage; check your VIN with a Hyundai dealer. A replacement engine outside any coverage costs much more.

items.t: Hood secondary latch may not hold
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 16V-348. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Trailer hitch wiring keeps brake lights on
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 16V-842 (and 16V-147 for 2016 trailer turn signals). Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Tow hitch wiring module can short and burn
items.job: Remove tow hitch wiring harness and install dust cap
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 25V-893. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Idle stop oil pump controller can overheat
items.job: Replace idle stop oil pump controller
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 23V-526. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Roof moldings may come off
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 23V-038. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Loss of power steering assist
items.job: Replace power steering electric power pack
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 24V-412. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Can shift out of Park without the brake
items.job: Reroute shifter console wiring per recall
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 24V-877. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Connecting rod bolts may be under-tightened
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 25V-549. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Instrument display can go blank
items.note: Free dealer repair under recalls 26V-047 and 26V-400. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Unexpected automatic emergency braking
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 26V-316. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Side curtain air bags may be installed wrong
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 25V-809. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Side impact sensor may be misassembled
items.job: Inspect and replace side impact sensor
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 26V-254. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.

items.t: Check engine light with a knock sensor code and engine noise
items.job: Inspect engine, replace short block if damaged
items.note: Often free under Hyundai campaign T3G or the extended engine warranty. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Headlights or taillights can stop working (recall)
items.job: Reflash the central control unit software
items.note: Free dealer repair under recall 21V-938. Check your VIN or ask a Hyundai dealer.
